name: 工单详情页

properties.name: text
properties.expression: If(String.IsNullOrEmpty(提示), "未找到该工单", 提示)

properties.name: text
properties.expression: Enum.ItemToText(Enum.工单状态, 工单.工单状态)

properties.name: color
properties.expression: Switch(Enum.ItemToText(Enum.工单状态, 工单.工单状态), "待审批", "#FAAD14", "处理中", "#1677FF", "待客户确认", "#13C2C2", "已完成", "#52C41A", "已关闭", "#8C8C8C", "已驳回", "#FF4D4F", "已取消", "#BFBFBF", "#1677FF")

properties.name: text
properties.expression: Enum.ItemToText(Enum.工单优先级, 工单.优先级)

properties.name: color
properties.expression: Switch(Enum.ItemToText(Enum.工单优先级, 工单.优先级), "紧急", "#FF4D4F", "高", "#FAAD14", "中", "#1677FF", "#52C41A")

properties.name: text
properties.expression: If(工单.是否逾期, "已逾期", "未逾期")

properties.name: text
properties.expression: Enum.ItemToText(Enum.工单类型, 工单.工单类型)

properties.name: text
properties.expression: Enum.ItemToText(Enum.工单来源, 工单.来源渠道)

properties.name: text
properties.expression: IfError(Enum.ItemToText(Enum.客户等级, 工单.客户.客户等级), "-")

properties.name: text
properties.expression: IfError(工单.处理人.姓名, "待分派")

properties.name: text
properties.expression: FormatDateTime(工单.期望完成时间, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm", "-")

properties.name: text
properties.expression: If(String.IsNullOrEmpty(工单.审批意见), "-", 工单.审批意见)

events.name: 打开补充弹窗
events.description: 打开补充信息弹窗并预填当前工单内容

visible.expression: And(工单.工单状态 = Enum.工单状态.已驳回, 工单.提交人.登录名 = Client.currentUser.用户名)

events.name: 前往审批页
events.description: 携带待办任务标识进入工单审批页处理工单

properties.name: text
properties.expression: If(String.IsNullOrEmpty(待办节点名称), "处理/跟进", "处理/跟进：" & 待办节点名称)

visible.expression: And(Not(String.IsNullOrEmpty(待办任务ID)), 工单.工单状态 <> Enum.工单状态.待客户确认)

events.name: 前往确认任务
events.description: 携带待办任务标识进入工单审批页完成客户确认

visible.expression: And(工单.工单状态 = Enum.工单状态.待客户确认, And(工单.提交人.登录名 = Client.currentUser.用户名, Not(String.IsNullOrEmpty(待办任务ID))))

events.name: 打开待办任务中心
events.description: 前往待办任务中心打开待确认任务

visible.expression: And(String.IsNullOrEmpty(待办任务ID), Or(Or(工单.工单状态 = Enum.工单状态.待审批, 工单.工单状态 = Enum.工单状态.处理中), 工单.工单状态 = Enum.工单状态.待客户确认))

events.name: 打开取消弹窗
events.description: 打开取消工单弹窗并清空取消原因

visible.expression: Or(Or(工单.工单状态 = Enum.工单状态.待审批, 工单.工单状态 = Enum.工单状态.处理中), 工单.工单状态 = Enum.工单状态.已驳回)

properties.name: text
properties.expression: Enum.ItemToText(Enum.处理记录类型, current.item.记录类型)

properties.name: text
properties.expression: FormatNumber(工单.评价.满意度评分, "0") & " 分"

properties.name: text
properties.expression: If(String.IsNullOrEmpty(工单.评价.评价内容), "-", 工单.评价.评价内容)

properties.name: text
properties.expression: FormatDateTime(工单.评价.评价时间, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm", "-")

properties.name: placeholder
properties.literal: 请补充问题描述后重新提交

events.name: 提交补充信息
events.description: 校验补充内容并重新提交工单

content.literal: 请填写补充后的问题描述
工单已重新提交，等待客服主管审批

properties.name: placeholder
properties.literal: 请填写取消原因，取消后工单将终止流程并置为已取消

events.name: 提交取消工单
events.description: 校验取消原因后调用取消工单逻辑，并刷新工单详情

content.expression: If(String.IsNullOrEmpty(取消结果提示), "取消失败，请稍后重试", 取消结果提示)
If(String.IsNullOrEmpty(取消结果提示), "工单已取消", 取消结果提示)

events.name: 页面加载
events.description: 进入页面时加载工单详情与待办任务入口

logics.name: 加载工单详情
logics.description: 按工单标识查询工单完整详情

logics.name: 刷新待办任务
logics.description: 查询工单当前待办任务，供详情页直达处理入口

title: 工单详情
